Task: Bulk Modulus of Magnesium
Description: Calculate the bulk modulus of magnesium by computing the full elastic stiffness tensor using finite deformation and stress analysis. Use the Embedded Atom Method (EAM) potential for magnesium. Apply small finite deformations in each of the six independent strain modes (ε₁ to ε₆ in Voigt notation: ε₁ = ε<sub>xx</sub>, ε₂ = ε<sub>yy</sub>, ε₃ = ε<sub>zz</sub>, ε₄ = 2ε<sub>yz</sub>, ε₅ = 2ε<sub>xz</sub>, ε₆ = 2ε<sub>xy</sub>), one at a time. From the resulting stress-strain data, compute the full 6×6 elastic stiffness matrix (C<sub>ij</sub>). Report the bulk modulus in GPa via Voigt averaging.

Required submission format:
numerical value without units (eg. 56.00)


Available input data:
All the potentials, can be found at /potentials/. Note that in case of reaxff potentials, pair style 'reax/c' has been renamed to 'reaxff' and always use NULL for the control file (cfile), for example, this syntax is correct : pair_style reaxff NULL.

Thought: The EAM potential file for magnesium is "Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy". I will now proceed to write the LAMMPS input script using this potential file, the converted structure data file, and the necessary simulation parameters to calculate the elastic stiffness tensor and subsequently the bulk modulus.

Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_0/lammps_input.in", "content": "
units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p
read_data /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/react/bulk_modulus/brief/tasks/magnesium_bulk_modulus_trial_0/magnesium_structure.data

pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /potentials/EAM/Mg_Zhou04.eam.alloy Mg

min_style cg
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Apply small deformations and calculate stress
variable delta equal 1e-06

# Loop over strain modes
variable i loop 6
label loop_start

# Apply deformation
if "${i} == 1" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0 0"
if "${i} == 2" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_delta 0"
if "${i} == 3" then "displace_atoms all move 0 0 v_delta"
if "${i} == 4" then "displace_atoms all move 0 v_delta v_delta"
if "${i} == 5" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta 0 v_delta"
if "${i} == 6" then "displace_atoms all move v_delta v_delta 0"

# Run minimization
minimize 1e-10 1e-10 100000 100000

# Output stress
thermo_style custom step lx ly lz press pxx pyy pzz pxy pxz pyz
thermo 1
run 0

# Next strain mode
next i
goto loop_start
"}
